definitions.gloss: powerful nation; strong country; great power
definitions.explanation: A nation with significant military, economic, or political strength on the world stage.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}{強国|きょうこく}になる。
{世界|せかい}の{軍事|ぐんじ}{強国|きょうこく}が{集|あつ}まった。
この{国|くに}は{技術|ぎじゅつ}{強国|きょうこく}として{知|し}られ、{多|おお}くのイノベーションを{生|う}み{出|だ}してきた。
examples.english: This country is known as a technological powerhouse and has produced many innovations.

notes:
USAGE:
{強国|きょうこく} is often used with a modifier specifying the type of strength: {経済|けいざい}{強国|きょうこく} (economic power), {軍事|ぐんじ}{強国|きょうこく} (military power), {技術|ぎじゅつ}{強国|きょうこく} (technological power).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済|けいざい}{強国|きょうこく} (economic powerhouse)
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{強国|きょうこく} (military power)
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}{強国|きょうこく} (technological power)
- {強国|きょうこく}になる (to become a powerful nation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大国|たいこく} (great power, major country) focuses more on size and overall influence.
